references.text: Peter quotes this verse in his speech at the temple, linking it to the promise of a prophet whom the Lord will raise up, whom Israel must listen to.
Stephen quotes Moses' words about the prophet who was to come and confirms that God approved the people's desire for a mediator.
The people asked Moses to be a mediator between them and God because they feared hearing God's voice directly, something God here confirms was right.
Moses recounts that the Lord heard the people's words and confirmed that they spoke rightly when they asked for a mediator.
Philip identifies Jesus as the prophet Moses wrote about, the fulfillment of the promise God gave here.
The people recognize Jesus as 'the prophet who is to come into the world,' a reference to the promised prophet God approved sending.
